segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I had 28 current seats on the business analytics package, and you were looking at adding the operations team before the June 17 go-live. Is that still the right count?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Close. We trimmed it a bit. It’s 24 additional seats, so 52 total. Finance wants the invoice to show the new seats separately for cost center 410.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 24 net-new, 52 total, and the invoice line called out for cost center 410. With the mid-year add, the prorated amount through your March 31 renewal is $18,720.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Does that include the two admin workshops we talked about, or is that separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. Two remote admin workshops, 90 minutes each, one the week of June 10 and one after launch. If you want a third session later, that would be $1,200, but it’s not in this order.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, two is fine. Contract term stays aligned to March 31, right? We don’t want a separate renewal date.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, co-termed to March 31, 2027. Same payment terms as your current agreement, net 30. No change to the main terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For go-live, we need the seats active by June 12 so we can test permissions before the 17th.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that works. If you sign by Friday, June 6, we’ll activate the seats on June 11 and send the admin workshop times in the same confirmation.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send the order form to me and copy Mark in finance. He’ll issue the PO once he sees the $18,720 and the cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it this afternoon with the seat count, co-term date, invoice note, and June 11 activation date. Anything else finance needs on there?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just our billing address: 1840 North Carson, Suite 300, Reno. Otherwise that’s it.
